What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of a left-opening parabola is the right-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13955030/assets/80c3336af95cf45198f4d8cf3b8718c7dcd2512f4720948d0edda3d987a6aa0c.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(0,5).$
